name: Night Hunter cuts Huntress Saber's cooldown by 60 seconds (#3198)
contract: Night Hunter 801146 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11), EffectBasePoints -60001 with DieSides 1 (-60000 ms) and EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0x40, 0). Huntress Saber 524643 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32) has RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 180000 (category 111) but SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 0), so SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod never matched the mask and the cooldown stayed 180 s; the shipped fix sets SpellFamilyFlags word1 bit 0x40 on 524643 in AscensionStarcaller::ApplyContracts. Native path: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns runs ApplySpellMod SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN on the recovery time, and the cooldown_ms metric reads Player::GetSpellCooldownDelay. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level, so the only difference is the flat modifier: the control must show the full 180 s and the talented fixture 120 s (the windows allow a few seconds of elapsed time after the cast). If the cast is refused the cooldown stays 0 and the control assertion fails visibly. Not run by the author.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control cooldown starts at the full 180 s
Talented cooldown is 60 s shorter (120 s), within a few seconds of elapsed time
